title: Automated scoring & routing for Private/VPC/on-prem networking and air-gapped requests
creator: Asha Raman
description: Problem: We receive a high volume of inbound requests for Private/VPC/on-prem deployments that include complex networking, upgrade, and air-gapped constraints. Current manual triage is slow, inconsistent across SEs/PMs, and results in delayed scoping and inaccurate prioritization. Goal: Create an automated scoring and routing system that classifies each request by technical complexity, upgrade risk, and business priority and routes to the appropriate team (Solutions Eng, Dedicated Sales, On-prem Engineering) while surfacing required preflight steps to customers.
acceptance_criteria: A public intake form change is live capturing standardized fields for network topology, outbound connectivity, internal registries, KMS/HSM use, OS lock-down, and upgrade cadence
Automated scorer produces a numeric ComplexityScore (0-100) and a BusinessPriority score (0-100) for 95% of inbound requests
Routing rules send requests with ComplexityScore >= 65 to On-prem Engineering queue, 40-64 to Solutions Eng, <40 to Sales Triage
Dashboards in Console show daily intake volume, distribution by ComplexityScore buckets, and average time-to-first-response per bucket
Integrations: intake results written to CRM (Salesforce) and create Linear ticket with pre-populated recommended next steps and estimated effort
Performance: scoring latency < 3s for synchronous validation path and < 30s for full enrichment path
Security: scoring flow does not persist customer secrets; any uploaded artifacts are quarantined per data retention policy
proposed_workflow: 1) Customer or SE submits intake form (new structured fields)
2) Pre-validation checks run (IP blocks, region constraints) and quick heuristics applied
3) Scoring engine computes ComplexityScore and BusinessPriority; attaches reason tags (network, airgap, upgrade-risk)
4) Enrichment: asynchronous agents fetch region availability, patching policy defaults, and historical customer usage (if allowed) to refine score
5) Routing: create Linear ticket in relevant team queue and post summary to Solutions Slack channel with recommended next step template
6) Notify customer with a triage summary and expected SLA for human follow-up
scoring_model: ComplexityScore = round(0.45*NetworkDifficulty + 0.25*AirgapStrictness + 0.15*UpgradeRisk + 0.15*CustomIntegrationWeight) where each component is normalized 0-100. BusinessPriority = round(0.6*ARREstimate + 0.25*StrategicAccountFlag + 0.15*TimeSensitivity). Reason tags: network, registry, proxy, windows, k8s, airgap, upgrade. Thresholds are configurable via admin console.
implementation_tasks: PM: finalize intake field spec and customer-facing copy
Design: add new intake UI + email summary template
Frontend: implement structured form and client-side validations
Backend: scoring service skeleton, enrichment hooks, datastore for transient artifacts
Infra: secure upload quarantine area, retention policy, S3 encryption+KMS integration
Integrations: Salesforce mapping, Linear ticket template and webhook, Slack alert channel
Console: dashboard for intake volume and score distribution
Docs/SE enablement: playbook for interpreting scores and recommended runbooks
Security: threat model review and sign-off (required)
